thread:
Jules: FYI Nimbus Analytics wants to run a 6-week POC and will bring their own model family (nimbus-11b-extended). Needs: low-latency streaming chat, function-calls, 30k+ token KV sessions, and EU data residency with customer-managed KMS. Can we scope compatibility + timeline?
Priya: Got it. Do they have a HF repo or will they upload weights to our S3? Any custom tokenizer/merges?
Jules: Theyre uploading to our secure S3 and will include tokenizer files. They mentioned mixed rotary/ALiBi attention and a custom RMSNorm layer.
Omar: RMSNorm vs LayerNorm matters for kernel selection. Also need to confirm rotary params and whether attention is grouped-query. Tokenizer check is priority.
Hannah: Security note: they require a KMS integration where customer holds keys and we only see wrapped keys. Also audit logs, rotation policy, and a filled infosec questionnaire.
Jules: I'll request the presigned S3 bundle + completed questionnaire and a single security POC contact.
Priya: Commercial question: delta between Hosted vs Dedicated for Nimbus-11b. If we recommend q4_kv vs fp16 what should we tell them about cost/latency tradeoffs?
Omar: Ballpark: fp16 on H100 ~70ms/token at 2k context; q4_kv typically ~2.0x token-cost reduction but may add ~10-25ms/token depending on dequant path and sequence length. Dedicated reserved capacity flattens p95 and helps meet SLA.
Hannah: For 30k token KV sessions we need to check sharded KV correctness and memory footprint. If they plan contiguous 30k windows we may need segmented attention or larger instance classes. We'll document limits.
Jules: Action plan proposed: 1) request weights + tokenizer + manifest 2) run compat scan (tokenizer, attention, norm) 3) build recommended variants (fp16, q4_kv, explore int8) 4) run 48h Dedicated canary and produce p50/p95/cost numbers 5) infosec KMS/residency signoff.
Omar: While we wait for weights I'll run synthetic runs against a similar 11B open model to provide a baseline estimate.
Priya: I'll draft a POC quote: hosted vs 3mo/6mo dedicated uplift + one-time onboarding fee to cover compatibility engineering and certs.
Hannah: I'll own the infosec questionnaire responses and ask them for their KMS endpoint cert and threat model. Also include legal for EU residency clause.
SecureBot: onboard-checklist created: ONB-240123 (steps: ingest weights -> tokenizer sanity -> compat-scan -> variant-build -> 48h canary -> KMS review).
Jules: Can someone paste a sample streaming + function-call curl we can give Nimbus for dev testing?
Omar: Sample below (we'll replace model_id after variant build):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"nimbus-11b-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Generate monthly trends"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_ticket","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Priya: Nice. Assignments: @Omar -> compat scan + perf baseline, @Hannah -> infosec/KMS/legal, @Priya -> pricing/commercial, @Jules -> customer coord and S3 retrieval.
Jules: Can we promise initial compatibility feedback within 2 business days after full artifact (weights + tokenizer + manifest) arrives?
Omar: Yes, assuming artifacts are complete. Full canary metrics after 48h of steady traffic.
Hannah: Quick question for the team: Nimbus wants assurance that model checkpoints won't be exfiltrated during onboarding. Can we provide a short blurb on our secure ingest and audit controls?
Priya: We should include that in the SOW and the onboarding pack. I'll draft standard language for the customer about secure ingest, ephemeral access to weights, and audit logs.
Jules: Great. I'll update Nimbus and ask for presigned S3 + questionnaire. Thanks all :thumbsup:
